scope: do not reclassify complete bcrypt hashes as plaintext generic passwords

filter_scope.constraint: entire extracted value, not a marker anywhere on the line

safety: Typed secrets and neighboring plaintext credentials are preserved; malformed, truncated, extended, or unsupported-format values remain candidates.

validation.source: isolated clean HEAD plus only the three-file bcrypt change
validation.race: targeted bcrypt and generic-password integration tests passed
validation.minimum_go: go1.26.11 targeted bcrypt and generic-password tests passed

ci_gate.environment: empty temporary PROWL_HOME; embedded portable model; pinned bundled rule directory
ci_gate.harness_adjustment: only fixture cleanup disabled to retain generated files; scoring and thresholds unchanged

validation.default_profile_attempt: correctly aborted with exit 2 because a user-installed legacy model has an incompatible feature schema; no user model changed

qualification: local historical subset gate only; does not establish live verification, full-dataset business lift, or release publication readiness
